bachelor:finance.overview: Finance at UE-Varna delivers comprehensive training in corporate finance, investment analysis, financial markets, and risk management. Students gain hands-on experience with financial modelling and valuation techniques, preparing them for careers in banking, investment, and financial consulting.
bachelor:finance.keyFocus: Corporate finance, investment analysis, financial markets, risk management, portfolio theory
highlights: Access to Bloomberg Terminal and financial databases
Mandatory internship in a financial institution
State-subsidised and paid study options available
admissionNotes: Admission based on secondary school diploma GPA
Mathematics as a profiled subject strongly recommended

Erasmus+ exchange with marketing-focused partner universities
admissionNotes: Admission based on secondary school diploma GPA
State-subsidised and paid study options available

bachelor:business-and-management-in-engl.overview: Business and Management in English at UE-Varna is designed for students seeking an internationally oriented business education. The curriculum covers management principles, marketing, finance, and entrepreneurship, all taught in English. Students develop cross-cultural communication skills and strategic thinking through case studies and team projects.
bachelor:business-and-management-in-engl.keyFocus: International management, cross-cultural business communication, strategic decision-making, entrepreneurship
highlights: Fully taught in English — no Bulgarian language requirement
Mandatory internship semester with partner companies
Access to Erasmus+ exchange at 120+ partner universities
Open Doors policy: direct networking with 200+ business partners
admissionNotes: Admission based on secondary school diploma GPA
B2-level English certificate required (IELTS 5.5+, TOEFL 72+, or equivalent)
Apply online at priem.ue-varna.bg by July for regular intake

bachelor:business-economics.keyFocus: Microeconomics, macroeconomics, econometrics, business analytics, market research
highlights: Access to Bloomberg Terminal and economic databases
admissionNotes: Admission based on secondary school diploma GPA
Mathematics or economics as a profiled subject recommended
